in_sanskrit.name: तारन्वीर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root words तार (tār, star) and वीर (vīr, hero, warrior). The name Taranveer means 'Star, Radiant, Victorious'.

in_marathi.name: Taranveer
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory, Overcoming Obstacles
in_marathi.long_meaning: Taranveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Taranveer is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Taran' which means 'to save, deliver' and 'Veer' which means 'brave, hero'.
